def select_next_node(current_node, destination_node, unvisited_nodes, distance_matrix):
    def score_node(next_node, current_node, destination_node, distance_matrix, accumulated_distance):
        proximity_score = distance_matrix[current_node][next_node]
        accumulated_distance += proximity_score
        remaining_distance_score = distance_matrix[next_node][destination_node]
        return proximity_score + remaining_distance_score * 0.5 + accumulated_distance * 0.1

    accumulated_distance = 0
    next_node = min(unvisited_nodes, key=lambda node: score_node(node, current_node, destination_node, distance_matrix, accumulated_distance))
    return next_node
